description: The Voltage IBE Cryptographic Module is a component of the Voltage IBEToolkit, a set of development tools that enable any application to quicklyand easily use Identity Based Encryption (IBE) to secure data. IBE usessimple strings like email or IP addresses as public keys, eliminating theneed for certificates and associated management. The Voltage IBECryptographic Module also contains implementations of 3DES, AES, SHA-1, andDSA. The Voltage IBE Toolkit is available for download athttp://developer.voltage.com
